description: The chart represents the distribution of task types, showing the proportion of different tasks. The chart is divided into three slices. The largest slice, colored red, represents "Article generation" and occupies approximately 83% of the chart. The second slice, colored blue, represents "Article editing" and is labeled with a percentage of 14.6%. The smallest slice, colored yellow, represents "Headline generation" and is labeled with a percentage of 2.4%. The chart includes percentage labels outside the chart for "Article editing" and "Headline generation", and the slices are arranged in a clockwise order from largest to smallest.
